fields.title: Proper Hand Wash
fields.description: Proper hand wash is the step-by-step process of cleaning your hands using clean water and soap to remove dirt, germs, and viruses. It includes scrubbing all parts of the hands—palms, back of hands, between fingers, and under nails—for at least 20 seconds to ensure effective hygiene and prevent the spread of illness.
author: capstoneadmincvsu

fields.title: Mother's Day Craft
fields.description: Mother’s Day Craft is a simple handmade creation made to show love and appreciation for mothers. It often uses basic materials like paper, colors, and decorations to create cards, gifts, or personalized items that express heartfelt messages and gratitude.
author: capstoneadmincvsu

fields.title: SASasASasa
fields.description: AsaSAsaS

fields.title: Decoration Craft
fields.description: A Decoration Craft video showcases creative and artistic ways to design, decorate, or personalize items using handmade techniques and craft materials. It often includes step-by-step tutorials for making decorations such as room décor, party decorations, DIY gifts, or recycled art projects, helping viewers improve their creativity and crafting skills.
author: capstoneadmincvsu

fields.title: COLOR MIXING PRIMARY COLORS
fields.description: Color Mixing: Primary Colors is an activity that demonstrates how the three primary colors red, blue, and yellow can be combined to create different colors. By mixing these colors, we can produce secondary colors such as orange, green, and violet.
author: johnsent

fields.title: COLOR MIXING SECONDARY COLORS
fields.description: Color Mixing: Secondary Colors is an activity that shows how secondary colors are created by mixing two primary colors. The three secondary colors are orange, green, and violet, made by combining red + yellow, blue + yellow, and red + blue.
author: johnsent

fields.title: Handwash
fields.description: Handwashing is a simple way to keep our hands clean and free from germs. Kids should wash their hands with soap and water to stay healthy and avoid getting sick. It’s important to wash before eating, after using the toilet, and after playing outside.
fields.description_tl: Ang paghuhugas ng kamay ay isang simpleng paraan upang mapanatiling malinis at malayo sa mikrobyo ang ating mga kamay. Ang mga bata ay dapat maghugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon at tubig upang manatiling malusog at maiwasan ang pagkakasakit. Mahalagang maghugas bago kumain, pagkatapos gumamit ng palikuran, at pagkatapos maglaro sa labas.

fields.title: Brushing teeth
fields.description: Brushing your teeth keeps your mouth clean and healthy by removing dirt and germs. It helps prevent cavities and keeps your smile fresh and bright.
fields.description_tl: Ang pagsipilyo ng ngipin ay nagpapanatili ng kalinisan at kalusugan ng iyong bibig sa pamamagitan ng pag-alis ng dumi at mikrobyo. Nakatutulong ito upang maiwasan ang sirang ngipin at pinapanatiling sariwa at masigla ang iyong ngiti.

fields.title: Nail Cleaning
fields.description: Nail cleaning is an important part of personal hygiene. It helps remove dirt, bacteria, and germs from under and around the nails using tools like a nail cutter and nail file. Keeping nails clean prevents infections and keeps your hands looking neat and healthy.
fields.description_tl: Ang paglilinis ng kuko ay isang mahalagang bahagi ng personal na kalinisan. Nakatutulong ito na alisin ang dumi, bakterya, at mikrobyo sa ilalim at paligid ng mga kuko gamit ang mga kagamitan tulad ng gupit-kuko at kikil. Ang pagpapanatiling malinis ng mga kuko ay nakaiwas sa impeksyon at nagpapanatiling maayos ang iyong mga kamay.

fields.title: Thank you Gift Card
fields.description: A Thank You Gift Card is a simple, thoughtful card designed to show appreciation. It features a clear “Thank You” message, clean and pleasant design, and space for a short personal note. It’s a small but meaningful way to express gratitude.
fields.description_tl: Ang Thank You Gift Card ay isang simpleng kard na ginawa upang magpakita ng pagpapahalaga. Nagtataglay ito ng malinaw na mensahe ng pasasalamat, maayos na disenyo, at espasyo para sa maikling personal na sulat. Isang munting paraan upang magpahayag ng taos-pusong pasasalamat.

fields.title: Birthday Card
fields.description: Creating a birthday card involves designing a cheerful and colorful card with a clear birthday greeting and fun decorations. It includes space for a short personal message to make the celebrant feel special and appreciated.
fields.description_tl: Ang paggawa ng birthday card ay kinabibilangan ng pagdisenyo ng makulay at masayang kard na may malinaw na bati sa kaarawan at mga palamuti. Mayroon itong espasyo para sa maikling mensahe upang maipadama ang pagmamahal sa nagdiriwang.

fields.title: Craft a Father’s and Mother’s Day card
fields.description: Crafting a Father’s and Mother’s Day card involves creating a heartfelt card with a warm message and simple decorations to show love and appreciation for both parents.
fields.title_tl: Kard para sa Araw ng mga Ama at Ina
fields.description_tl: Ang paggawa ng kard para sa Araw ng mga Ama at Ina ay paglikha ng taos-pusong kard na may mainit na mensahe at simpleng palamuti upang ipakita ang pagmamahal at pagpapahalaga sa ating mga magulang.

fields.title: DIY Board Game
fields.description: A DIY board game is a creative activity where you design and build your own game, including rules, board layout, and pieces, making it fun and personalized to play.
fields.description_tl: Ang DIY board game ay isang malikhaing gawain kung saan magdidisenyo at bubuo ka ng sarili mong laro, kabilang ang mga patakaran, layout ng board, at mga pyesa, na ginagawang masaya at natatangi ang paglalaro.

fields.title: Simple Musical Instrument
fields.description: A simple musical instrument is an easy-to-make tool that produces sound using basic materials, allowing anyone to create music in a fun and creative way.
fields.description_tl: Ang simpleng instrumentong pangmusika ay isang madaling buuing kagamitan na gumagawa ng tunog gamit ang mga pangkaraniwang kagamitan sa bahay, na nagbibigay-daan sa sinuman na lumikha ng musika sa masayang paraan.

fields.title: Animals Coloring Book and Color & Shape Matching
fields.description: Color and shape activities help learners recognize and identify different colors and basic shapes, improving their visual understanding and early cognitive skills in a fun, simple way.
fields.title_tl: Aklat ng Pagkukulay ng mga Hayop at Pagtutugma ng Kulay at Hugis
fields.description_tl: Ang mga gawain sa kulay at hugis ay tumutulong sa mga mag-aaral na makakilala ng iba't ibang kulay at batayang hugis, na nagpapabuti ng kanilang visual understanding at maagang kasanayan sa masayang paraan.

fields.title: Painting Crafts
fields.description: Painting crafts are creative activities where you use paint to decorate or design objects, surfaces, or artworks. They help express imagination, improve artistic skills, and can be done on materials like paper, canvas, wood, or recycled items.
fields.description_tl: Ang mga sining sa pagpipinta ay mga malikhaing gawain kung saan gumagamit ka ng pintura upang magpalamuti o magdisenyo ng mga bagay o likhang-sining. Tumutulong ito na maipahayag ang imahinasyon at mapahusay ang kasanayan sa sining.

fields.title: Recycled Materials Craft
fields.description: Recycled materials crafts are creative projects made from reused or repurposed items like plastic bottles, cardboard, paper, or tin cans. These crafts help reduce waste while encouraging imagination, turning old or discarded materials into useful, fun, or decorative creations.
fields.description_tl: Ang mga sining gamit ang recycled materials ay mga malikhaing proyekto na gawa sa mga ginamit muling bagay tulad ng basyong bote, karton, o lata. Nakatutulong ito sa pagbabawas ng basura habang hinihikayat ang imahinasyon.

fields.title: Paper & Card Board Craft - Greeting Card
fields.description: Paper and cardboard greeting card crafts involve designing and decorating cards using simple materials like colored paper, cardboard, and art supplies. These crafts let you create personalized, handmade cards for any occasion by cutting, folding, and adding creative designs or messages.
fields.title_tl: Sining sa Papel at Karton - Kard na Bati
fields.description_tl: Ang mga sining sa kard na bati gamit ang papel at karton ay kinabibilangan ng pagdisenyo at pagpapalamuti ng mga kard gamit ang simpleng kagamitan tulad ng makukulay na papel, karton, at kagamitang pansasining.

fields.title: Simple Science Experiments - Volcano Models
fields.description: Simple science experiment volcano models are fun, hands-on projects that simulate a volcanic eruption using safe household materials. They help demonstrate basic scientific concepts like chemical reactions while allowing learners to build and decorate their own model volcano.
fields.title_tl: Simpleng Eksperimento sa Siyensya - Modelong Bulkan
fields.description_tl: Ang simpleng eksperimento ng modelong bulkan ay masaya at hands-on na proyekto na nagpapakita ng pagsabog ng bulkan gamit ang ligtas na kagamitan sa bahay. Ipinapakita nito ang mga batayang konseptong siyentipiko tulad ng chemical reaction habang nagbubuo ng sariling bulkan.

fields.title: Handwash
fields.description: Handwashing is a simple way to keep our hands clean and free from germs. Kids should wash their hands with soap and water to stay healthy and avoid getting sick. It’s important to wash before eating, after using the toilet, and after playing outside.
fields.description_tl: Ang paghuhugas ng kamay ay isang simpleng paraan upang mapanatiling malinis at malayo sa mikrobyo ang ating mga kamay. Ang mga bata ay dapat maghugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon at tubig upang manatiling malusog at maiwasan ang pagkakasakit. Mahalagang maghugas bago kumain, pagkatapos gumamit ng palikuran, at pagkatapos maglaro sa labas.

fields.title: Learning Goal
fields.description: A Learning Goal is a clear, specific statement that defines what a learner aims to know, understand, or be able to do by the end of a learning period or project.
fields.description_tl: Ang Layunin sa Pagkakatuto ay isang malinaw at tiyak na pahayag na nagtatakda kung ano ang layunin ng mag-aaral na malaman, maunawaan, o magawa sa pagtatapos ng aralin o proyekto.
author: capstoneadmincvsu

fields.title: Story Book Craft
fields.description: Storybook crafting is the creative process of designing and making handmade, tangible books or interactive book-related art. It bridges the gap between creative writing and physical artistry, focusing on how the story is visually and physically presented.
fields.description_tl: Ang paggawa ng aklat ng kuwento ay ang malikhaing proseso ng pagdisenyo at pagbuo ng mga handmade na aklat o sining na may kaugnayan sa kuwento. Iniuugnay nito ang malikhaing pagsulat at pisikal na sining.
author: capstoneadmincvsu

fields.title: NEW YEAR PAPER CROWN
fields.description: A fun and easy paper crown craft for celebrating the New Year. Kids can decorate it with colors, stars, and other festive designs.
fields.description_tl: Isang masaya at madaling paper crown na maaaring gawin para salubungin ang Bagong Taon. Maaaring palamutihan ito ng mga bata gamit ang kulay, bituin, at iba pang disenyo.
author: johnsent

fields.title: NUMBER WHEELS
fields.description: A fun learning craft that helps kids recognize and practice numbers using a colorful rotating wheel.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang learning craft na tumutulong sa mga bata na makilala at magsanay sa mga numero gamit ang makulay na umiikot na wheel.
author: johnsent

fields.title: ADDITION WHEEL
fields.description: A fun learning activity that helps kids practice addition using a colorful and interactive wheel.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang learning activity na tumutulong sa mga bata na magsanay sa addition gamit ang makulay at interactive na wheel.
author: johnsent

fields.title: DIY MULTIPLICATION
fields.description: A fun and simple activity that helps kids practice multiplication using creative and interactive materials.
fields.description_tl: Isang masaya at simpleng gawain na tumutulong sa mga bata na magsanay sa multiplication gamit ang malikhaing at interactive na materyales.
author: johnsent

fields.title: DIY FRACTION WHEELS
fields.description: A fun and colorful activity that helps kids understand fractions by dividing a wheel into equal parts.
fields.description_tl: Isang masaya at makulay na gawain na tumutulong sa mga bata na maunawaan ang fractions sa pamamagitan ng paghahati ng wheel sa pantay na bahagi.
author: johnsent

fields.title: MATH PUZZLE BOARD
fields.description: A fun and educational activity that helps kids practice math skills by solving simple puzzles and number challenges.
fields.description_tl: Isang masaya at educational na gawain na tumutulong sa mga bata na magsanay sa math skills sa pamamagitan ng pagsagot ng mga simpleng puzzle at number challenges.
author: johnsent

fields.title: GEOMETRIC SHAPES
fields.description: A fun learning activity that helps kids recognize and identify different geometric shapes through colorful and creative designs.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang learning activity na tumutulong sa mga bata na makilala at matukoy ang iba't ibang geometric shapes gamit ang makulay at malikhaing disenyo.
author: johnsent

fields.title: COLOR MIXING
fields.description: A fun activity that teaches kids how to mix colors and discover new colors through simple experiments.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang gawain na nagtuturo sa mga bata kung paano maghalo ng mga kulay at makabuo ng bagong kulay sa pamamagitan ng simpleng eksperimento.
author: johnsent

fields.title: SOLID,LIQUID AND GAS
fields.description: A fun science activity that helps kids learn about the three states of matter through simple examples and experiments.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang science activity na tumutulong sa mga bata na matutunan ang tatlong estado ng matter—solid, liquid, at gas—gamit ang simpleng halimbawa at eksperimento.
author: johnsent

fields.title: FOOD CHAIN
fields.description: A fun science activity that helps kids understand how energy moves from plants to animals through a simple food chain.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang science activity na tumutulong sa mga bata na maunawaan kung paano dumadaloy ang enerhiya mula sa mga halaman papunta sa mga hayop sa pamamagitan ng food chain.
author: johnsent

fields.title: PROJECT PHOTOSYNTHESIS
fields.description: A fun science project that helps kids understand how plants make their own food using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang science project na tumutulong sa mga bata na maunawaan kung paano gumagawa ng sariling pagkain ang mga halaman gamit ang sikat ng araw, tubig, at carbon dioxide.
author: johnsent

fields.title: SOLAR SYSTEM MODEL
fields.description: A fun science project that helps kids learn about the Sun, planets, and their positions in the solar system.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang science project na tumutulong sa mga bata na matutunan ang tungkol sa Araw, mga planeta, at kanilang mga posisyon sa solar system.
author: johnsent

fields.title: DIY VOLCANO
fields.description: A fun science project that lets kids create a simple volcano model and observe a safe chemical reaction.
fields.description_tl: Isang masayang science project na nagpapagawa sa mga bata ng simpleng modelo ng bulkan at nagpapakita ng ligtas na chemical reaction.
author: johnsent
